summary: An eight-wheeled infantry fighting vehicle with a turret cannon. It moves fast, shreds infantry and light vehicles, and carries a full squad to the front, though its passengers cannot fire out.

sections.title: Turret cannon
sections.how: Select the ZBL-09 and left-click an enemy, or let it fire at anything in range.
sections.body: The turret cannon fires quick, accurate shots. It is deadly against infantry, scouts and light vehicles, and can answer low drones, but it barely scratches a main battle tank.

sections.title: Carry infantry
sections.how: Select infantry, then left-click the ZBL-09.
sections.body: Up to eight soldiers ride inside. If the ZBL-09 is destroyed its riders get out with light wounds, but while inside they cannot shoot out: the ZBL-09 has no firing ports. Riders cannot be selected until they leave.

sections.title: Unload
sections.how: Select the loaded ZBL-09 and press Unload (n).
sections.body: The riders step out one after another beside the vehicle. Drive close to the objective first, then unload.

sections.title: Repair at the vehicle factory
sections.how: Select the damaged ZBL-09 and press Repair at factory, or left-click your vehicle factory.
sections.body: The ZBL-09 drives to the factory and is repaired for half its price, paid as the health comes back.

strong: Carrying a squad to the front
tips: Pair it with the Type 99A: the tank fights armour, the ZBL-09 clears the infantry around it.
Unload anti-tank teams behind cover instead of driving the ZBL-09 into a tank.
Composite armour from the vehicle factory adds health to the ZBL-09.
